ORDER % 27.03.2026 CRL.M.A. 9409/2026 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.
CRL.M.(BAIL) 635/2026

3. By way of the instant application, the applicant seeks extension of interim bail for a period of one month granted vide order dated 12.02.2026, in case arising out of FIR bearing no. 475/2021,
registered at Police Station Dwarka, Sector-23, Delhi for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 420/468/471/120B/467/419 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC').
4. Issue notice.
The learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.
5. The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that This is a digitally signed order.

sentences.text: The learned APP appearing on behalf of the State does not oppose the present interim bail application.

7. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the present case, also keeping in mind the medical condition of the applicant, this Court is inclined to extent the interim bail of the applicant for a period of four weeks from date, on the same terms and conditions imposed by this Court, vide order dated 12.02.2026.

It is further clarified that since the surgery of the applicant has been conducted and he has been advised bed rest, he need not appear before the concerned Investigation Officer (I.O.) during the period of interim bail on weekly basis, as it is not possible for him to appear before the IO.
However, the applicant will make phone call to the IO to apprise him about his whereabouts.
8. It is also clarified that immediately after the expiry of interim bail, the applicant shall surrender before the concerned Jail Superintendent.
9. In view of above terms, the present application stands disposed of.
10. The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
DR. SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J MARCH 27, 2026/A/GJ
